# Range

Range — slider over a numeric span. A range input carries its value, never its meaning: "49" says nothing about what is being set. `label` is the only thing that names it, so it takes the same pair as `Input` — `label` for the text, `showLabel={false}` to hide that text without taking the name away (#213). Built on Base UI's Slider, wrapped in `FieldFrame` (A7) for the disabled fade. Base UI's Slider has no DOM-query label lookup the way Checkbox and Radio do — `Slider.Thumb`'s accessible name only ever comes from an explicit `aria-label`/`aria-labelledby` or an ambient `Field.Label` registration — so the label here points at the thumb directly via `aria-labelledby` on `Slider.Root`, which `Slider.Root` forwards to every `Slider.Thumb` beneath it.

Also asked as: slider, range slider.

**Import:** `import { Range } from '@/components';`

## Usage

Use a range in a form to let a person choose a value within a minimum and a maximum, when an approximate value is enough: a zoom level, a volume, a rough rating of effort.

Do not use a range when choosing a specific value matters. A slider is less precise than typing a number or picking an option from a list. Do not use it for values that are not numeric, such as weekdays, or for spans that are extremely large (over 100 steps) or very small (1 to 3).

## Best practices

### Use size 12 by default. {#use-size-12-by-default}

The 12 handle and its track are easy to read and to grab in a standard form.

Do: Size 12 in a standard form.
Don't: Size 8 for a primary input.

### Use one size per form. {#use-one-size-per-form}

Matching sizes keep several ranges aligned.

Do: Every range in the form uses size 12.
Don't: Size 12 and size 8 in the same form.

### Use size 16 for touch. {#use-size-16-for-touch}

A thicker track is a larger target.

Do: Size 16 where touch is the main input.
Don't: Size 8 on a touch screen.

### Put the label directly above the slider. {#put-the-label-directly-above-the-slider}

Keep it short and aligned left. Show it unless the layout already names the slider.

Do: The label sits above the slider and names it.
Don't: The label is hidden, so nothing on screen names the slider.

### `onChange` reports a number. {#onchange-reports-a-number}

The first argument is the new value as a number; the event follows. A handler that wrote `event.target.value` reads the second argument instead.

### In a left-to-right layout the lowest value is on the left. {#in-a-left-to-right-layout-the-lowest-value-is-on-the-left}

In a right-to-left layout it is on the right.

### Use helper text to explain how. {#use-helper-text-to-explain-how}

If the slider needs explaining, put one line of helper text under it rather than a longer label.

## Accessibility

- **Label every slider.** A range input carries its value, never its meaning: "49" says nothing about what is being set. `label` is the only thing that names it.
- **`showLabel={false}` hides the text, not the name.** The label stays in the page for assistive technology.
- **Arrow keys step the value by `step`; Home and End jump to `min` and `max`.**
- **Keyboard focus is a 2px ring on `border.focused`, 2px off the handle.** A pointer focus draws none.
- **Do not use a range where precision matters.** Offer a text field beside it, or use one instead.

## Related

- For a specific numeric value, use Text field.
- For a choice among a few options, use Radio or Select.
- For a rating, use Rating.

## Parts

1. **Label.** 14/20 text directly above the slider, aligned left. It names the slider.
2. **Track.** A 4 line showing the span (6 or 8 with `size` 12 or 16). It fills with the selected bold fill from the start to the handle.
3. **Handle.** A 20 circle, or 8, 12 or 16 when `size` is set, that the person moves along the track to change the value.

### States

| State | What changes |
| --- | --- |
| Rest | The track fills with `--ds-background-selected-bold` from the start to the handle. |
| Hovered | The handle takes `--ds-background-selected-bold-hovered`. |
| Pressed | While the handle is dragged it reads the same as hovered. |
| Focused | A 2px ring in `--ds-border-focused`, 2px off the handle, for keyboard focus only. |
| Disabled | Track and fill take `--ds-background-disabled`; the handle takes `--ds-icon-disabled` with no shadow. Out of the tab order. |
| Invalid, read-only | Not drawn. A range always holds a value, so there is nothing to mark invalid. |

### Tokens

| Part | Token |
| --- | --- |
| Track | `--ds-background-neutral`; fill `--ds-background-selected-bold`; height `--range-track-height-4`. |
| Handle | `--range-dot-size-default` (20), `--ds-background-selected-bold`, `--ds-shadow-raised`. |
| Size | `--range-dot-size-8`, `-12`, `-16`; track `--range-track-height-4`, `-6`, `-8`. |
| Corner | `--radius-full` on track, fill and handle. |
| Hit area | `--item-height-md` (32), the whole row. |
| Label | `--ds-text`, body default; gap `--space-025`. |

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Name what the slider sets: "Zoom", "Volume". | An instruction: "Slide to choose a zoom level." |
| Keep the label to one or two words. | A sentence that wraps above the slider. |
| Use one line of helper text under the slider to explain how. | A longer label. |
| Use sentence case and no end punctuation. | Title case, or a period after the label. |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `id` | string | — | — |
| `name` | string | — | — |
| `label` | node | — | Text that names the slider. Without it the slider has no accessible name. |
| `showLabel` | bool | `true` | Render the label visually hidden rather than visible. It still names the slider. |
| `min` | number | `0` | The smallest value. Defaults to 0. |
| `max` | number | `100` | The largest value. Defaults to 100. |
| `value` | number | — | The current value, for a controlled slider. Pair it with `onChange`, or use `defaultValue` to leave the slider uncontrolled. |
| `defaultValue` | number | — | — |
| `step` | number | `1` | How much the value moves per key press or drag step. Defaults to 1. |
| `isDisabled` | bool | `false` | Prevents interaction and dims the slider. |
| `size` | enum | — | The dot and bar, in px; the track follows. Unset keeps the default rendering. |
| `onChange` | func | — | Called with the new value as a number, then the change event. |
| `className` | string | `''` | — |
| `style` | object | — | — |
